composition.summary: The agent followed all compliance rules, including delivering the disclaimer before discussing benefits and collecting the Scope of Appointment before scheduling the appointment. The call was focused on a Humana PDP plan.

One suggestion: consider adding a brief reminder about the importance of reviewing the Scope of Appointment before the scheduled meeting to ensure the customer is prepared.
